records.source: Lose more eggs when you're knocked out

[textcolor black][letterbg LooseSprites\\troutDerbyLetterBG 0]        -----Trout Derby-----^^This weekend, Summer 20th through 21st:^^Come prove your freshwater skills and win prizes!^^(Note: Any personal items found near this sign will be sent to the lost and found)
records.translation: [textcolor black][letterbg LooseSprites\\troutDerbyLetterBG 0]        -----鱒魚大賽-----^^本週末，夏季 20 日至 21 日：^^來證明你的淡水釣魚技巧並贏取獎品！^^（注意：在此告示牌附近發現的任何私人物品都會送至失物招領處）

records.source: [textcolor black][letterbg LooseSprites\\squidFestLetterBG 0]             -----SquidFest-----^^Friday the 12th and Saturday the 13th.^^A two-day squid fishing bonanza. If you can reach our daily catch targets, you'll win prizes.^^(Note: Any personal items found near this sign will be sent to the lost and found)
records.translation: [textcolor black][letterbg LooseSprites\\squidFestLetterBG 0]             -----魷魚節-----^^星期五 12 日與星期六 13 日。^^為期兩天的魷魚垂釣盛會。只要達成每日捕獲目標，就能贏得獎品。^^（注意：在此告示牌附近發現的任何私人物品都會送至失物招領處）

records.source: Is... Is that for me?$u#$b#Wow! This exactly what I wanted... Thank you! You're so nice!$h
records.translation: 這……這是給我的嗎？$u#$b#哇！這正是我想要的……謝謝你！你人真好！$h

records.source: Welcome to the Trout Derby! What can I do for you?
records.translation: 歡迎參加鱒魚大賽！有什麼能為你效勞？

records.source: During this event, Rainbow Trout have a chance of carrying a 'Golden Tag'. If you find one, turn it in here for a prize!
records.translation: 活動期間，虹鱒有機會帶著「金色標籤」。找到後交到這裡，就能換取獎品！

records.source: Looks like your bag's full. Better make some room first.
records.translation: 看來你的背包滿了。最好先騰出一些空間。

records.source: Seems like you don't have any Golden Tags... better get fishing!
records.translation: 看來你沒有金色標籤……快去釣魚吧！

records.source: The Annual Trout Derby has begun.
records.translation: 一年一度的鱒魚大賽開始了。

records.source: The Desert Festival is now open!
Welcome to SquidFest! What can I do for you?
records.translation: 歡迎參加魷魚節！有什麼能為你效勞？

records.source: It's a squid fishing challenge! If you can hit our daily catch targets, you'll win prizes. Check the sign to the left. We also put special bait in the water so the squid are active all day!
records.translation: 這是一場魷魚垂釣挑戰！只要達成每日捕獲目標，就能贏得獎品。請查看左邊的告示牌。我們還在水中放了特殊魚餌，讓魷魚整天都很活躍！

records.source: You haven't earned any rewards yet. Better start catching some squid!
records.translation: 你還沒有獲得任何獎勵。快開始捕捉魷魚吧！

records.source: You don't have any rewards available right now. Keep catching more squid!
records.translation: 目前沒有可領取的獎勵。繼續捕捉更多魷魚！

records.source: Congratulations! You hit our iridium-level target and earned all possible rewards for today.
records.translation: 恭喜！你達成了銥級目標，並獲得今天所有可領取的獎勵。
需要更多空間才能搭設。

records.source: A green rain has descended upon the valley.
Only a master of the five ways may enter. ({0}/5)
records.translation: 唯有精通五道的大師才能進入。（{0}/5）

records.source: You've got some new ideas to sleep on...
records.translation: 你有了一些新點子，睡一覺再好好想想……
